blurb: Guests take 30-minute scenic flights over the White Mountains and Mount Washington Valley, plus an additional 15 minutes for prep, take off, and landing. Flights can be standard or special location requests within a 25 mile radius of Fryeburg, Maine. The local pilot has over 30 years of experience flying in the area.
